title: introduce-telemetry-fuse-weighted-sampling-and-autobrief
author: Nikhil Rao
release_notes: Add TelemetryFuse service to synthesize weighted sample sets from production telemetry and a new AutoBrief generator to produce concise release notes summarizing profile deltas and perf regressions.
description: Motivation: Release engineering and model curation teams need a reliable way to derive representative evaluation slices from production traffic and to automatically produce human-readable release briefs that surface performance regressions and key metadata changes. This PR introduces TelemetryFuse (a small service + pipeline) that ingests sparse runtime telemetry, computes importance-weighted sample sets for onboarding/evals, and hooks into the changelog/autobrief generator to produce concise release summaries. Key goals: reduce manual sampling overhead, improve alerting signal for profile regressions, and automate draft release notes. Changes in this PR include: 1) TelemetryFuse service and CLI for sampling heuristics | 2) WeightedSample serializer and compact manifest stubs for model variants | 3) AutoBrief generator that ingests profile delta output and emits short, structured blurb candidates for release notes | 4) CI hooks and minimal e2e smoke test for the pipeline | 5) docs/readme and onboarding checklist updates. Checklist: [x] Telemetry sampling engine implemented [x] Unit tests for weighting heuristics [x] AutoBrief templating + examples [x] Integration test for end-to-end manifest->brief generation [x] Docs and migration notes. Commits summary: commit 1: add telemetry-fuse service skeleton and protobufs (initial sketch, CLI) | commit 2: implement weighted sampling algorithm and offline simulator (importance sampling based on token distribution + route weights) | commit 3: add AutoBrief summarizer + template library and mapping rules from profile deltas to candidate blurbs | commit 4: tests, CI, docs, and migration guide. Changed areas (high level): services/telemetry-fuse/main.py (service entry, sample orchestration), services/telemetry-fuse/weighting.py (core heuristics and tunables), registry/manifest/stub_serializer.py (compact manifest stub writer), registry/autobrief/generator.py (rule-based brief synthesis), tests/telemetry_fuse/test_weighting.py (unit tests), docs/model-onboard/telemetry-fuse.md (usage and migration), .github/workflows/telemetry-fuse-smoke.yml (e2e smoke pipeline). Small illustrative snippet: weighting.py exposes compute_weights(events, config) -> list of sample ids and weights; config supports time_decay_alpha and route_priority_map. Review conversation: Reviewer Aisha Gomez: "Nice work on the sampling model; two small naming nits and a question about default decay constant." Author (Nikhil): "Renamed the variable and added comments; default alpha set to 0.97 but exposed via CLI flag; added rationale to docs." Reviewer Liam O'Connor: "Can we guarantee manifests remain stable when sampling seed changes? Suggest adding a seed export in the stub." Author: "Added deterministic-seed field to manifest stubs and a test asserting stable output for a given seed." Reviewer Sofia Martinez: "AutoBrief is promising; please add one example that shows a false positive regression suppressed by heuristics." Author: "Added sample in docs that demonstrates suppression via min-sample-count filter and threshold gating." CI summary: initial run failed lint on template naming; fixed in commit 3; full pipeline now passes (unit tests + smoke e2e). Migration notes: operators should run telemetry-fuse with --dry-run against existing telemetry exports to validate sample coverage and inspect generated manifest stubs before adopting as primary sampling source. Backwards compatibility: manifests are additive and include a version tag; existing downstream onboarding code will ignore unknown fields. Related: ties to ENG-845 (automated profile sampling) and ENG-913 (release automation). Testing notes: unit coverage for weighting heuristics 92%; integration smoke covers end-to-end manifest->autobrief path on a synthetic 10k-event export. Follow-ups: bake the telemetry-fuse pipeline into scheduled nightly jobs, add a stability metric for auto-brief hallucination rate and add an opt-in mode for teams to receive suggested notes as draft PRs. Merge outcome: merged via squash on 2024-11-12 after approvals from all reviewers and CI green.
